description: Read one AI line draft from quotes.draftFromVisit, not a customer quote. Each line's state (draft, approved or rejected), where the price came from, the shop's lessons, and the next line to read to the worker. For a customer quote, use quotes.get.
name: quotes_draft

unit_price_minor.description: Amount in minor units of the currency (cents), or null.

next_actions.description: Up to 3 useful next steps, best first, in plain words. op names the op to call, when there is one. when is now, later, check, or tell_human. due_at is set for later and check when there is a natural time. A send is tell_human: show the owner the draft, then send only when they say so.
